name: Deadrig 'Noxious' Shotgun
description: The Deadrig is a high powered, double-barreled shotgun with a simple design pieced together from junkyard scraps. Prioritizing power above all else, the Deadrig lacks the refinement of mass-produced weapons and suffers from heavy recoil. The Noxious variant features more green coloration due to the scrap metal used during its assembly.
